scope: Infinitesimal planar bending, zero offset, uniform host spacing h and beam spacing l=2h/3, default linear translation trace with independently interpolated nodal rotations
derivation: Across two host intervals, three beam intervals have mean shear gamma=w_chord_prime+mean(theta_y) equal to (-k*h/6,0,+k*h/6)
The native Beam2 mean-shear energy is l*S_eff*gamma^2/2, S_eff=(1/S+l^2/(12*E*Ib))^-1 and S=(5/6)*G*Ab
Summing the periodic intervals gives U_extra/L=S_eff*k^2*h^2/108 and added bending rigidity DeltaB=S_eff*h^2/54
For h large compared with sqrt(27*E*Ib/S), the extra rigidity approaches E*Ib/2 and need not decrease appreciably over the coarse range
At fixed physical section and h tending to zero, DeltaB tends to S*h^2/54 and ultimately vanishes quadratically
evidence_context: The retained zero-offset default nonmatching cases have substantial rotation errors; the finite eccentric prescribed-state audit independently measured nonzero default beam shear and near-zero director-trace shear with internally consistent native work
implication: A decreasing coarse continuum error or one near-accurate refinement may reflect competing errors; neither proves the default trace has reached its asymptotic regime
not_proof_of: The error or equilibrium of the running nx64 finite-rotation eccentric case
Acceptance of the director option or permission to replace legacy/default behavior
prospective_decision: If completed nx64 errors increase, stop its default refinement family under the adopted predicate. Root must explicitly choose a justified compatible implementation/qualification route before another method or trace is tested; preserve legacy failures and all original physical acceptance criteria.
